name: Gemini CLI
summary: Google's open-source terminal agent; consumes Agent Skills with .gemini/skills locations and a .agents/skills alias.

skillDiscovery.skillFormat: SKILL.md is the only required component; scripts/, references/, and assets/ are optional
documentedLocations: built-in skills bundled with the CLI
skillDiscovery.notes: Discovery precedence is lowest to highest: built-in skills, extension skills, user skills, then workspace skills. .agents/skills is documented as a compatible alternative to .gemini/skills, aligned with the agentskills.io standard. The Packsmith v0.1 target adapter still marks this runtime as planned (src/lib/targets.mjs) pending install-convention confirmation.

frontmatter.notes: The docs name two fields: name (a unique identifier that should match the directory name) and description ('CRITICAL. This is how Gemini decides when to use the skill.').
